about: TOPST AI-G board: NPU time = simulator (board clocks) + fixedMs + avgPoolMsPerMillion x average pooling (output values x kernel side, millions) + maxPoolStride2Scale x (simulator ms of stride-2 max pooling / 2) + bigStemMsPerMillion x first convolution larger than 3x3 (output pixels x 32-channel passes, millions) + depthwiseScale x (simulator ms of depthwise convolutions / 2). Fitted to the times measured on the board (engine/helpers/board_time.py, design section 11).
